MAYOR’S BUDGET MESSAGE




The Governing Body held a goal setting session in January and one of our goals was to develop
$1,000,000 in new revenue for this budget. We will be working to find those sources in the com-
ing year to offset the anticipated revenue losses and always increasing expenses we expect to in-
cur in the near future. For example, one key area we will focus effort on is our fee structures.
Many of our fees have not been adjusted since 1993 so our goal is to objectively look at our cost
of doing business and adjust our fees to match that cost.

I look forward to meeting with the City Council and the public to work through this budget. I
know we will maximize the dollars we are blessed to have to benefit our employees and the pub-
lic.

Very Truly Yours,



Patrick J. Collins
Mayor




                                                  City of Cheyenne’s ADOPTED FISCAL YEAR 2022 BUDGET  Page 7
